hooks.name: git-ai-pre-write
hooks.description: Before kiro writes a file: flush pending dirty content as human-attributed and stash the path for the matching PostToolUse (vonage-git-ai)

hooks.name: git-ai-post-write
hooks.description: After kiro writes a file: send a git-ai agent-v1 checkpoint marking the new content as AI-authored by kiro (vonage-git-ai)
